purpose: Humanoid robots as human-form machines whose locomotion, manipulation, autonomy, supervision, safety, and operating cost require separate evidence.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name model, task, setting, version, and human intervention. Distinguish visual resemblance from general capability and disclose teleoperation.
